hooks.name: doc-sync
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, ask the agent to bring KIRO_USAGE.md, README.md and the spec's tasks.md up to date with what actually changed.

action.prompt:
A spec task just finished. Update the docs to match what was actually done, and nothing more:
1. In the spec's tasks.md, tick the checkbox only if the task is fully implemented and its tests pass.
2. In KIRO_USAGE.md, update the sections this task touched (custom agents, hooks, spec-driven vs vibe coding, steering, MCP, property-based testing, powers, Lighthouse and axe scores). Describe only what happened; mark planned work as not yet done; never invent scores, users or numbers.
3. In README.md, update How to run, How to test, Pre-existing work (every new dependency, font or sound with its license) and Project status if they changed.
4. Use no em dashes. Do not commit; leave the changes for review.
